transcription: She was my boss's favorite employee. Mine too but only after hours, they say you shouldn't sleep with co-workers. They especially say you shouldn't sleep with ones who wear wedding rings and laugh too loudly when your boss makes a joke. But rules don't mean much when it's 642p. The office is mostly dark, and Olivia is sitting on the edge of your desk and heel she hasn't taken off since 8 a. Asking you if you're staying late too. The first time it happened, it was in the file room. Second time, the supply closet. After that, hotels always are picking the place, always me paying for it. She said her husband was nice but unoriginal. Said he stopped touching her with intention a year ago. Said I made her feel like her name had teeth again. I didn't ask too many questions. We kept it clean in the office, mostly except once when she slipped her hand into my lap during a quarterly review. Every time she texted 430 meeting, it meant one thing. And every time I told myself this would be the last. But I started noticing things. Her perfume lasted longer on my clothes. She stopped leaving right after. One night, she fell asleep next to me in the hotel bed and whispered, sometimes I think I love you more than I should. That did something to me. So I did something stupid. I wrote her a letter. Nothing too dramatic. Just that I felt it too. That I wasn't just in it for the sex. That maybe we could be something real if she ever left him. I slipped it in her purse the day she went home early for a headache. She never mentioned it. The next week, she avoided me. Canceled every 430 meeting. Smiled in the halls like nothing had happened. I thought she was scared. Then I saw her walking into HR. Later that day, I got an email for your conduct. Your employment is being terminated effective immediately. I packed my desk in silence. Olivia never looked my way. As I waited for the elevator, she walked by with her husband. He smiled at me.
